name: vault.export
description: Exports the whole vault as one re-importable archive, or an OKF bundle; owner only. Delivery transfer keeps it on the server and answers a transfer_ref, read at /v1/core/export-transfers/{transfer_ref} or vault.export.transfer.read.

docs.ts: /** Exports the whole vault as one re-importable archive (ZIP, base64 in `archive`); `notices` names each world it carries that the owner's recipient choice would keep from where it goes. */
docs.py: Exports the whole vault as one re-importable archive (ZIP, base64 in `archive`); `notices` names each world it carries that the owner's recipient choice would keep from where it goes.
